title: Retail credit up 18.8% to ₹185.2 trillion; EU steel duty on India #Shorts
description:
Retail credit rose 18.8% year on year to ₹185.2 trillion in Q2 FY27, the EU imposed anti-dumping duty on steel imports from India, and margin-funded stock purchases reached ₹1.53 trillion, per Business Standard.

Sources: Business Standard
